Name: Iron Man - Red and Gold Armor (Fashion Sense)
Author: Juchliate
Description:
Suit up as Iron Man in Stardew Valley! This Fashion Sense pack includes a red and gold helmet, chestplate, gauntlets, and leg armor made in pixel art.

Iron Man gently bobs in the air while standing still. When moving, he switches to a glide pose in each of the four directions, with open gauntlets and his boots pointed downward. He stays airborne while using tools, with arm animations for tool use.

Requirements
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
• Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or later

Installation
1. Install SMAPI and Fashion Sense.
2. Install this pack with Vortex, or extract the [FS] Iron Man folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
4. Open the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror and apply the Iron Man outfit from the outfits menu.

If you're updating from an earlier version, reapply the outfit in the mirror after installing the update.

The preview GIF shows the four glide sprites. In-game transitions and tool alignment are still to be verified.
